profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Systems Engineer, with wide experience in software development. Interested in solving big challenges. Solid skills and knowledge in distributed applications, abilities for database modeling, and algorithms optimization. Agile Development Oriented.

Talk to me about E-commerce or Fintech and you'll get my full attention for hours xD

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Software Engineer in charge of delivering software, architect systems, provide technical mentorship, collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions and continuously enhance system performance, focusing on meeting customer needs using the best practices for designing scalable distributed systems.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Design · Software Infrastructure · Terraform · Kotlin · Python · Databases · GraphQL · C# · Bash

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Delivering software e-commerce features for several boldcommerce.com applications mostly related to payment flows, service integrations, and transaction reliability.

In charge of:
- Features Development and release.
- Code Reviews.
- Scrum facilitator (Scrum master).
- Architecture design proposals.
- Incident responder.
- Third-party integrations

Tools:
Software Development: Go, PHP, Reactjs.
Process: Scrum, Kanban.
Web Service: RESTful.
Databases: MySQL, REDIS.
Frameworks: Laravel, ReactJS, Wordpress
Queues Management: RabbitMQ

positions.title: Software Engineer Sr.
positions.description:
Providing software solutions to the oil and gas industry, mostly associated with drilling and production enhancement. Serving as Agile Coach and Software Engineer in Realtime Data Transfers Expert, Data Acquisition Expert, Drilling Consultant, Hydraulics, Safety, and Continuous Improvement.

In charge of:
- Team Dev Leader.
- Features Development and release.
- Code Reviews.
- Scrum facilitator (Scrum master).
- Architecture design proposals.
- Incident responder.
- Third-party integrations.

Tools and Software Languages:
Python, Nodejs, Angular, .NET Core
MSSQL Server, PgSQL, Apache Solar, Hive.
Kafka, Nifi, WitsML

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Partido de Vicente López, Gran Buenos Aires, Argentina
positions.description:
Facing challenges on a daily basis to provide scalable solutions to Latin America's biggest e-commerce platform, mainly assigned to mercadopago.com (fintech branch)

Involved in high scale applications written using several high-performance tools as:
Golang, Python, Elasticsearch, Cassandra, Kibana, Datadog, Newrelic, Pulsar.

In charge of:
- Features Development and release.
- Code Reviews.
- Architecture design proposals.
- Incident responder.
- Third-party integrations.

Main Accomplishments:
MercadoPago virtual wallet timeline development
+140k request per minute handling
Loyalties Points integration.

positions.title: Software Developer Technical Lead
positions.description:
Software Developer, assigned to three main projects: Claro Video (Internet Streaming) and Claro Drive (Cloud Storage). Working in payments processing business flows.

In charge of:
- Team Dev Leader.
- Features Development and release.
- Code Reviews.
- Scrum facilitator (Scrum master).
- Architecture design proposals.
- Incident responder.
- Third-party integrations.

Main Accomplishments:
TDD Implementation for a full project.
RabbitMQ implementation for queue processes.
10+ New Payment Methods integrations.
Payment Subscriptions implementation.
One time Payments using third party providers.

Tools:
Software Development: Java, Python, JavaScript, PHP, Ruby.
Devops: Git, Jenkins, Sumologic, Nagios, AWS, Heroku, VMWare.
Web Service: SOAP and RESTful.
Cache: Memcached, Redis.
Database: Oracle, Mongo, Cassandra, Elasticsearch.
Frameworks: Spring, ExpressJS, Protractor, SlimPHP, Bootstrap, RabbitMQ, RoR.
Processes: Scrum Development, Lean Process Management, Kanban

positions.title: System Engineer
positions.description:
Having several jobs and responsibilities: Software Developer, Drilling Service Delivery Engineer.

In charge of:
- Features Development and release.
- Code Reviews.
- Architecture design proposals.
- Incident responder.
- Third-party integrations.

Main Accomplishments:
Development and Deployment of 5 web service protocols integrations.
+300 Real time oil well drillings data transfer monitoring.
+60 Well sections drilled (as MLWD) without time loss or accidents.
Process Improvements using Lean and Kanban.


Tools:
Software Development: Java, Python.
Web Service: SOAP and RESTful.
Databases: Oracle, Cassandra.
Frameworks: Spark, Springboot, Flask.
Real-time data transfer: INSITE, INSITE Anywhere.
Transfer Protocols: Wits, Witsml.
Project Management: Scrum, Lean Process Management, Kanban, Jira, Sharepoint, KPI’s analysis.

projects.title: PPE Delivery Management Software
projects.description: This application was meant to support the Personal Protective Equipment management, improving response times at facing state audit.

projects.title: Drilling Laboratory Equipment Control Software
projects.description:
Software Developer in charge of development of the Web Application using Software Quality Standards.

It was a web application that succesfully accomplished to indentify and supress bottle necks on the journey to get drilling equipments ready to go and all this seasoned by the especially hard conditions and challenges present in the region of its implementation.

this was a Web Application implemented using: 
PHP, MySQL, JQuery, Bootstrap, SlimPHP, SAP, LDAP, SharePoint, among others.
